<thought>Based on the molecular formula C7H14O5 and a DBE of 1, a plausible structure is a seven‑carbon chain containing a single carboxylic acid (providing the DBE) and three hydroxyl groups. The SMILES “CC(O)C(O)C(O)CCC(=O)O” satisfies C7H14O5, has one double‑bond equivalent (the carbonyl), and includes the required number of oxygens.</thought>
<final_answer>CC(O)C(O)C(O)CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
